tasks.short: Teach basic academic, hygiene and social skills to preschool pupils with special needs.

steps.what: Teach basic skills and adapt prompts to each preschool pupils actual response
Write and check actual skill-practice observations in the existing pupil record
Save the checked actual skill observation

tasks.design: Keep actual instruction, demonstrations, prompting and response judgement human. Split the short actual observation write and save in {OTHER}, the pupil record system; its existing native observation form already accepts the teachers direct note, so no further change or saving is established.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual teaching depends on individual communication and physical or social needs.
tasks.enabler_now: Native records support a short direct observation entry; this does not replace observing or teaching.
tasks.still_hard: The teacher must respond to the child in the moment without inferring needs from a generated description.
tasks.human_edge: Trust, attention and responsive teaching help the pupil practise safely.
tasks.altitude: No change in teaching responsibility or decision rights.

evidence.claim: ParnasSys supports pupil records and learning-goal tracking; this capability does not establish automated live teaching.

assumptions: Boundary is actual basic-skills instruction and its short actual observation entry. Curriculum creation and long reports are not added as hidden teaching work.
The teacher observes actual responses in s1 and captures them in s2; no structured performance result or transcript arrives for free.
Provisional shares retain all teaching and actual writing. The native form and save are checked before concluding zero; no new mechanism means no incremental upkeep.
The note accuracy check is part of actual entry, not an extra approval step. The 1 percent fully retained save is schema granularity.
unknowns: Actual observation-entry practice during skills instruction
research_questions: Does direct observation capture contain any real duplicate transfer beyond the existing native form?

incremental.description: No new mechanism or ongoing upkeep

approvals.approved_version: s2 complete checked actual skill observation for the correct pupil

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Actual teaching and separately counted actual observation writing and native save retain full effort. No new benefit from existing record software or hypothetical report preparation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop individual educational plans for preschool pupils development.

steps.what: Gather and record actual pupil observations, assessments and family priorities for the plan
Design individual educational, physical or social goals and appropriate support approaches
Set up the individual plan form with exact checked references and selected goals
Write and correct the plan rationale from the teachers actual evidence and chosen support

loop.purpose: Draft only the teachers existing reasoning in the required plan prose
loop.input: Checked evidence, teacher-selected goals and support, and plan headings
loop.output: Source-linked rationale draft without new goals or diagnostic labels
loop.check: Teacher checks every claim against observations, preserves qualifications, rejects invented needs and checks omissions and false causal implications
loop.stop: Missing evidence, unsupported statements or two unsuccessful corrections return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native structured forms handle fixed references first; variable evidence-based rationale still needs prose correction

steps.what: Review the complete individual plan for meaning, evidence, feasibility and correct pupil scope
Save the checked final individual plan in the restricted pupil record

tasks.design: Use the native plan form in {OTHER}, the pupil record system, for exact checked references and teacher-selected goals. Only if substantive prose still repeats, trial bounded drafting in an authorised {DOCS} environment from the teachers actual evidence; retain corrected meaning review and save the complete checked plan separately without sending it to families or selecting goals automatically.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fixed plan fields and narrative may be re-entered despite existing pupil evidence.
tasks.enabler_now: Native plan forms handle fixed information; bounded drafting can restate a teachers existing rationale under direct review.
tasks.still_hard: Appropriate goals and supports require actual knowledge of the pupil and family context.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher owns developmental judgement and notices when fluent prose misstates the child.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated plan preparation; educational decisions and required consultation remain human.

evidence.claim: ParnasSys provides a pupil-record and individual support-plan module; this supports native structured planning, not proven automated plan judgement.
Model knowledge: bounded prose drafting can restate checked teacher notes but needs full semantic review and manual fallback.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher plan development through a restricted saved version. Existing family and specialist input is captured in s1; any required later consultation or external plan issue is not declared complete by this save.

The teacher captures pupil ID, dated observation sources, source-qualified assessment findings, actual family priorities, selected goal descriptions and chosen support in s1 and s2. Missing sources require manual completion; a draft never invents them.

Native forms are tested before prose drafting. Structured setup retains manual correction and the model sees only approved necessary evidence in an authorised environment; access must be established before use.
Shares and reductions are provisional. Existing configuration earns no new benefit. Draft review is in s4, complete plan review in s5, and the 1 percent save is fully retained schema granularity.
unknowns: Actual required plan consultation and record controls
research_questions: Can native forms remove repeated entry without new tooling?
Do reviewed draft rationales preserve every material qualification without inventing pupil needs?

already_counted.description: Corrected meaning review while writing the plan rationale

incremental.description: Maintain plan headings and examine failed drafting patterns

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete checked individual plan with actual evidence, teacher-selected goals and support

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional ten fixed-form points plus eight corrected prose points saves 18 minus two upkeep = 16. Half eligible form and prose work gives nine minus two = seven. Original capture, goal choice, final complete review and native save retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Meet families about pupil progress, community resources and support skills.

steps.what: Review actual pupil progress and relevant current community-resource information before the family meeting
Meet parents, discuss actual progress and teach relevant support skills or explain community resources
outputs: actual family discussion and support practice

steps.what: Write and check actual family concerns, discussed resources and agreed follow-up
inputs: actual family discussion and support practice

steps.what: Save the checked actual family meeting note

tasks.design: Configure native progress and selected resource links in {OTHER}, the pupil record system, retaining source reading and resource freshness checks. Keep the actual family conversation, practical support teaching and fresh outcome writing human; separately save the checked note without generating family statements or assuming a follow-up message was sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: The teacher may navigate separate progress entries and maintained resource references.
tasks.enabler_now: Native related-record views can shorten preparation without interpreting the family conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Families need sensitive explanation, practical demonstration and responses to actual concerns.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher builds trust and adjusts support to what the family can actually use.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less navigation; family partnership and advice responsibility remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: ParnasSys supports pupil records and goal tracking, which can provide native progress context for a teacher.
Model knowledge: selected current resource links can be maintained alongside a pupil meeting view without generating advice.

assumptions: Boundary is actual family meeting preparation, conversation and its short actual note. No separate long report, follow-up card or approval ceremony is invented.

Earlier actual observations produce progress entries; the schools maintained resource register supplies source and review date. The teacher checks both in s1 and manually locates absent sources within its retained time.
The teacher produces actual concerns and agreed actions only during s2 and captures them in s3. No transcript or structured meeting outcome is assumed.
Shares and reduction are provisional. Native view is tested first; existing links earn no new benefit. The existing note accuracy check covers the separate fully retained 1 percent save.
research_questions: Does a meeting sample reveal avoidable navigation while preserving full source and family-context checks?

incremental.description: Check resource-link freshness and meeting-view access

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete checked actual family meeting note for the correct pupil

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional native navigation reduces ten preparation units by half, saving five points minus 0.5 upkeep = 4.5. Half eligible navigation gives two. Actual meeting, practical teaching, outcome writing and save retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Modify preschool curriculum for pupils actual disability-related needs.

steps.what: Review general curriculum goals and actual pupil access and support needs
Choose appropriate curriculum changes, teaching approaches and accessibility requirements
Prepare adapted curriculum pages with native reusable activity and visual-support templates
Rewrite and correct activity wording according to the teachers chosen curriculum changes

loop.purpose: Restate selected activity language without choosing pupil goals or supports
loop.input: Original activity text and explicit teacher-selected wording and access constraints
loop.output: Candidate revised wording linked to original activity goals
loop.check: Teacher verifies preserved concepts, missing steps, literal comprehension, actual accessibility and absence of invented pupil claims or diagnostic labels
loop.stop: Unsupported adaptation, missing teacher constraints or two failed revisions return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates handle repeated page structure first; varied activity prose needs teacher-corrected rewriting

steps.what: Check practical activity usability and accessibility against the actual chosen teaching approach
Write and check the final adaptation rationale, material version and limitations
Save the checked final curriculum adaptation

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} activity and visual-support templates before new tooling. For varied activity wording only, trial bounded rewriting from the teachers explicit adaptations without pupil-identifying data; retain actual curricular decisions, accessibility and practical checks, rationale writing and a separate checked final save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated activity layout and wording can consume time after the teacher has chosen the adaptation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates and level-specific text rewriting can help prepare material while leaving adaptation judgement human.
tasks.still_hard: Simpler language is not proof of accessible or developmentally appropriate instruction.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher understands actual pupil abilities and tests whether an activity works in practice.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive material preparation; no new authority over curriculum or pupil placement.

evidence.claim: LessonUp supports rewriting text at another level; this supports bounded wording changes, not automatic special-education curriculum judgement.

assumptions: Boundary is adapting curriculum materials through a saved version; actual subsequent teaching remains separate and no pupil outcomes are inferred.

The teacher reads actual support evidence in s1 and specifies chosen goals, activity changes and accessibility requirements in s2. Drafting receives generic activity text and explicit constraints, not hidden pupil records. Missing constraints mean manual writing.
Native templates are tested first. Only repeated layout and corrected wording change; actual curricular choice and practical checks retain full effort.

Shares and reductions are provisional. Existing native features yield no new benefit. Meaning review is counted in s4; final rationale checking is actual writing accuracy, not new approval ceremony. The 1 percent save is fully retained schema granularity.
unknowns: Actual repeated layout and wording effort
Whether existing native tools already cover this work
research_questions: Do revised activities preserve concepts and usability under the teachers actual access requirements?

already_counted.description: Semantic and accessibility corrections within activity rewriting

incremental.description: Maintain approved templates and inspect failed wording patterns

approvals.approved_version: s6 complete checked curriculum adaptation with rationale version and limitations

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional native layout saves five points and corrected wording saves seven: 12 minus two upkeep = ten. Half eligible preparation gives six minus two = four. Actual pupil-context assessment, adaptation choice, practical checks, rationale and save retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Actual preschool instruction and developmental judgement remain human; native forms and corrected material drafting can reduce specific preparation work.
skills_to_grow: Check plan wording against actual observations and qualifications
Test activity accessibility rather than equating simpler text with suitability
Maintain accurate pupil-source and material-version links
role.ambitious_version: A teacher who prepares clearer evidence-linked plans and adaptations while preserving actual pupil and family relationships.
